title: 秘密のデート！？心たぎるランデブー

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today, I'm watching the Queen Elizabeth II Cup! The race is a heart-stopper in which the magical girl Umamusume, Sweep Tosho, comes out on top!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I hear some spectators call this race very prestigious. That means I'll become a princess if I win it, right?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm going to enter the Queen Elizabeth II Cup one day! With that decided, all I need to do is train! Princess☆Axe Kick! Hiyah!
